title: radiation.model_research_record/0.3
description: Candidate C record (5710 hardening per the Atlas review): one EXACT model x surface x region observation set. 0.2 changes: typed evidence objects (tier/source_id/url/retrieved_on/claim — free-text tiers like '[OOPS]' are structurally impossible); exact_model_id is nullable and reserved for VERIFIED provider tokens, unverified candidates carry candidate_model_label (allOf if/then, executed); the checker binds dates to real calendar days, enforces the documented 90-day review window, resolves every source_id against the typed register, and binds filenames. Research layer only (non-boot): an entry grants no tool, effect, identity, privacy guarantee, or legal conclusion. Executed by scripts/model_research_check.py via the ONE schema executor (check 40 keeps every keyword executed). 0.3 changes (5810, per the 5800 research-track review): explicit supersedes relation (a confirmed record can name the RETIRED filenames it replaces; the checker rejects any listed file still active — the candidate/confirmed duplicate class is now structurally detectable) and optional policy_attribute_confidence (policy claims carry their own confidence, separate from identity confidence). (uniqueItems intentionally not declared: the executor's closed keyword set does not execute it; R7 enforces supersedes-target uniqueness in code)

exact_model_id.description: the provider's own id token — reserved for VERIFIED ids only (exact_id_verified true); null while the exact string is uncaptured

exact_id_verified.description: true ONLY if the exact id string was read from an official surface on retrieved_on; strict boolean

candidate_model_label.description: REQUIRED while exact_id_verified is false: the working label, never presented as a provider token

region.description: endpoint region; use "undeclared" when no source pins one — never guess

retrieved_on.description: ISO calendar date; the checker validates the day exists (pattern alone is not a date)

review_after.description: re-review deadline; checker enforces retrieved_on <= review_after <= retrieved_on + 90 days (the documented review window)

retention_training_mode.description: surface-specific retention/training facts only; never a privacy guarantee

license_aup.description: license/AUP pointers and open questions; never a legal conclusion

tier.description: O=official provider surface, S=secondary, U=user report — an enum, not a substring convention

source_id.description: must resolve to a row in catalogs/model_research/sources/REGISTER.json with the SAME tier (checker-bound)

declarations.description: claims as TYPED evidence, each bound to the register by source_id + tier

local_observations.description: RADIATION-local observations only; session-contingent, never generalized

supersedes.description: explicit candidate-to-confirmed replacement relation (5810 review H1): each entry is the RETIRED record filename this record replaces; the checker rejects any listed file still present in the active records/ directory

policy_attribute_confidence.description: attribute-level confidence for POLICY claims (retention/training/AUP) — deliberately separate from identity confidence; 'low' while resting on secondary leads
